player_prompt.intro:
U na le Player {player_id}. U ntse u tseba Guess The Number.
U na le khotso ea ho bala nomoro ya pakeng tsa {min_number} le {max_number} ka hara {max_turns} turns.
Ebang u kenya ho uena, game e tla u fa hints ejerere 'higher' kapa 'lower'.
U ka u araba ka tsela eo u e tsebang. Noma ke nomoro e tsosang ka square brackets e tla u tsejoa e le uena guess. Ejere, [5].
Ebang u tseba, history ea uena guesses e tla u tsosolosa hape ka tlase. U sebetse information ho fihlela u feleze game pele u qete guesses.
Kenya uena guess.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Tsela ea phetoho e ile ya tsoa. Player {player_id} ha a arabele ka '[number]' e halalelang.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Mohato o sa sebetseng. Sebapali {player_id} se ile sa hakanya nomoro e ka ntle ho sebaka seo a neng a se boletse.
invalid_move.already_guessed: Mohato o fosahetseng. Sebapali {player_id} se se se hopole palo eo e leng ho eona.

outcome.win: Kea u lebohela! U ile ua hakanya nomoro e nepahetseng.
outcome.turn_limit: Mehato ea turn limit e fihlile. Guess: {guess}, Target: {target}
